text.15:18: Save him who stealeth the hearing, and them doth a clear flame pursue.
text.27:7: (Remember) when Moses said unto his household: Lo! I spy afar off a fire; I will bring you tidings thence, or bring to you a borrowed flame that ye may warm yourselves.
text.37:10: Save him who snatcheth a fragment, and there pursueth him a piercing flame.
text.72:9: And we used to sit on places (high) therein to listen. But he who listeneth now findeth a flame in wait for him;
